items.definition: AC 43.13-1B Chapter 11 (or the aircraft manufacturer's wiring data when it exists) is the primary standard for avionics wiring installation in a Part 145 shop, covering acceptable methods and practices.
items.analogy: Like the NEC (National Electrical Code) for building wiring — the governing standard that defines what acceptable practice means.

blocks.question: What is the most critical standard to follow when installing avionics wiring in a Part 145 environment?
choices: The STC holder's equipment installation manual exclusively
AC 43.13-1B or the aircraft manufacturer's wiring data
RTCA DO-178C software development assurance standards
blocks.feedback: AC 43.13-1B Chapter 11 is the governing standard for aircraft wiring acceptable methods and practices. Manufacturer-specific wiring data takes precedence when it exists. DO-160G covers environmental testing. DO-178C covers software — neither addresses physical wiring practices.
